statement: Used and refurbished H100 prices fell from as high as $50,000 per GPU in mid-2024 to a $25,000-$40,000 range holding steady from mid-2024 into early 2026, with used 8-GPU H100 servers at roughly $150,000-$180,000.
why: The retreat from peak resale prices and the subsequent flat range show the acute scarcity premium of 2024 has drained out of the secondary market.

impact.mechanism: Falling resale value for the prior flagship indicates secondary supply has loosened relative to the 2024 shortage, easing the cost of used capacity.

evidence.excerpt: traded as high as $50,000 per GPU during mid-2024
The NVIDIA H100's retail price held remarkably steady at $25,000-$40,000 from mid-2024 into early 2026

confidence.basis: One secondary listing survey with no disclosed methodology; the document warns to treat it as an April 2026 mark.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 18900.0 -> 40000.0 (tol 1%); sources: Hashrate Index
